posts.title: Getting started with Express
posts.body: I just started learning Express. I like how routes connect a URL to the code that handles it. What helped you understand middleware?
posts.author: Alex

comments.author: Sam
comments.body: Building a tiny app helped me most. Add one middleware at a time and log what it receives.

comments.author: Jamie
comments.body: The Express guide has a good explanation of the request and response objects.

posts.title: Small steps make debugging easier
posts.body: When I get stuck, I try to make one small change and check the result before moving on. It is much easier to see what caused a bug that way.
posts.author: Morgan

comments.author: Taylor
comments.body: Same here. A quick console.log can be useful while learning, too.

posts.title: What are you building this weekend?
posts.body: I'm making a simple post and comment app to practice Node.js, Express, and rendering views. What are you working on?
posts.author: Riley
